_meta.purpose: People who may be named in published output because their name is already public. Maintainer-approved. An empty list means nobody is exempt from redaction.
rules: Every entry needs a 'basis': why the name is already public, ideally a URL (for example the minutes naming a councillor, or the Mairie's page).
category is one of: elected_official, business_owner, other_public_figure.
business_owner entries need diffusion_checked=true. Sole traders can opt out of publication of their name in the SIRENE register; confirm they have not.
valid_from / valid_to (YYYY-MM-DD) limit when the exemption applies. Councillors change after elections; outside the window, or when a document's date is unknown, the person is redacted.
A listed person is still pseudonymised on any page where they appear as Vendeur / Acquereur / Proprietaire (private capacity).
